scope: synthetic failure/recovery scheduler fixture, not real model results

policy.order: all first attempts, then exactly one retry of each aborted case
policy.retry_trigger: engine abort, scaffold failure, infrastructure failure or worker exception; not an ordinary completed game with poor task outcome
policy.restart: whole case from the frozen initial state with fresh player histories
policy.seed: same original scenario and sampling seeds; no new temperature or hidden reseeding
policy.budget: original per-native-call budget on each attempt; all attempt costs retained
policy.report: first attempt and post-retry outcomes separately; incomplete utility remains missing

resources.note: Includes first and retry attempts; summed attempt durations are not parallel suite wall time
